body:
GET /api/v1/mailing-list/export (?format=csv|json), gated behind new mailinglist.export permission (granted to super_admin). New Store.ListForExport returns ciphertext only, handler decrypts via already-unlocked Vault, skips (doesn't abort on) a corrupted row, fails closed (503) while locked. 9 new tests, go test ./... clean. Live-verified: migration applied against real prod var/iduna.db, redeployed iduna.service, live endpoint 401s unauthenticated as expected. Commit 3a50395. Unblocks S245-04's export button.

⚓ ☃
title: S245-02: real export endpoint for the mailing-list Store
